prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production background raster for an original side-scrolling pixel-art game, Cyber Kingdom. Generate a beautiful wide 1536x1024 landscape background, no text or UI. A medieval dark-fantasy woodland where ancient dragons and magic dominate, survivors use subtle cyan dragon-crystal-powered machinery. Strict side-on game camera, atmospheric layers of ancient conifers, gnarled branches, moss, distant ruined gothic watchtowers, tiny amber lanterns, a pale crescent moon behind indigo clouds, blue mist low between trees, scattered faint cyan crystal veins in distant rocks. Art direction: meticulously hand-placed-looking pixel clusters, restrained 32-color teal/slate/indigo/lichen palette, amber accents, lovely readable silhouettes, no soft painterly brushstrokes, no vector triangles, no glossy 3D. The bottom edge is a straight horizontal grass-and-earth surface, terrain never climbs. Middle-lower 25 percent open, unobstructed for small characters and separate resource props. No people, no large foreground tree trunks blocking action, no collectible objects, no text, no logos. Beauty through depth, organic branching silhouettes, moonlight and selective crystal glow. Finished in-game scenic pixel background, not a concept-art poster.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent pixel-art game prop atlas, 1536x1024, exactly FOUR equal columns and TWO equal rows (8 cells, each 384x512). Original medieval cyber-fantasy, dragon-crystal technology. Genuine transparent alpha background; no checkerboard, no colored backdrop, no labels or grid lines. Every object isolated completely inside its own cell with 24 px padding, all objects strict side view, bases aligned 32 px above each cell bottom. TOP ROW from left to right: 1) beautiful ancient harvestable pine tree, gnarled bark, natural branching silhouette, clustered sage/teal foliage and two subtle small cyan crystals in trunk, full height fills cell; 2) cluster of faceted cyan dragon-crystal ore on dark rock; 3) lush low berry shrub with copper-pink berries; 4) weathered medieval salvage chest reinforced with steel and a narrow cyan rune lock. BOTTOM ROW from left to right: 1) small timber-and-stone forester hut, copper pipes, cyan crystal-powered saw wheel, stacked logs, dark teal shingle roof and amber lantern; 2) planted wheat bed with earth furrows, pale gold heads, small irrigation copper pipe, side elevation not top-down; 3) cut tree stump with roots, wood chips and small log pile; 4) elegant small deer with crystalline branching antlers, side view facing right. Style: cohesive high-quality hand-crafted pixel clusters, detailed readable silhouettes, warm wood, slate steel, muted foliage, selective cyan glow, subtle dark outline. Pixel-art assets for actual play, no blurry shading, no isometric perspective, no duplicate objects, no cropping, no text.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent side-view character animation sprite atlas for a pixel-art medieval cyber-fantasy game. Canvas 1536x1024. Exactly SIX equal columns and FOUR equal rows, each cell 256x256, generous empty margins. Genuine transparent alpha, no checkers, no background or ground shadows, no text or separators. Each cell holds the SAME adult human forester worker, full-body SIDE PROFILE FACING RIGHT, NOT a knight: simple teal hooded cloth work jacket, warm tan leather apron, dark trousers, brass mechanical right forearm with tiny cyan dragon-crystal light, work boots, carrying a woodcutter axe. Compact realistic pixel proportions (head not oversized), beautifully designed hand-crafted 16-bit pixel art, visible 2-3 px clusters, dark outline, same outfit/scale/palette in ALL 24 cells.
